data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
Ah. A visitor who actually looks like they're going somewhere.
Most people in this house have given up moving with any purpose.
Augustus Goldstein. Merchant. Eighty years in this place and my instincts are still sharp.

choices.text: What do you know about the Guardian?
I need the Blue Crystal Key.

data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
I suspect you're here about the Blue Crystal Key.
I know where it is. Whether I help you depends on whether we can do business.

data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
Cedric is principled, which I respect, even when it's inconvenient.
He confiscated my ledger about forty years ago. He claimed it was for safekeeping.
I maintain it was an overreach. He maintains it was procedure.
We have not reached an agreement on this point.

data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
The Blue Crystal Key, among other things.
Also my ledger, which Cedric confiscated on technical grounds I still dispute.
He won't open the vault without two conditions — the Seal secured and the ledger returned.
Which means I need the ledger back before either of us gets what we want.

data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
It's in Cedric's vault. He won't open it without two conditions — the Ancient Seal secured, and my ledger returned.
I can help you with Cedric if you help me first.
That's how business works, even here.

data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
My gold coins went missing in all of this. They're in the house somewhere — I couldn't tell you exactly where.
Bring them back to me and I'll write you a letter of introduction for Cedric.
He trusts procedure. A voucher from me gives you standing.
That's the deal.

data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
My gold coins — somewhere in the house.
You have {item_count:item=Gold Coins|bool:them/not found them yet}.
Bring them back and I'll write you the letter for Cedric.

data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
My coins. Still exactly the right weight.
*he counts them without looking down*
Splendid. A deal's a deal.

data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
Here — a letter of introduction. Show it to Cedric alongside the Seal and the Ledger.
I wrote it out years ago on the off chance someone came through here with actual initiative.
The Blue Crystal Key is in that vault. Get it, use it on the blue pedestal in the main hall.
All four pedestals — that's the end of this.

data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
Obtained Merchant Voucher
You now have {keys_collected|round} of 4 Crystal Keys.

data.speaker: Merchant
data.text:
The vault opened, the key is in your hands.
I've been waiting eighty years for someone with enough sense to do this.
I want it noted that I was helpful.
